items.text: There is no single national polytechnic entry test.
Students worry about getting a seat.
Use this check on every trade you shortlist.
Look at the plants, sites, workshops or service shops within a few hours of home.
Count real employers, not brochure sectors.
Lateral entry lets a diploma holder join the second year of B.E. or B.Tech.
AICTE-linked notices give a diploma with at least 45% in engineering and technology.
Andhra Pradesh uses AP ECET, and lateral seats are about 10% above sanctioned intake in the colleges it covers.
Every trade gets the same worry: will AI make this pointless.
One industry report says AI tools can already automate a large share of specific drafting sub-tasks, from about 30% to 90% depending on the task.
Electrical safety, civil site supervision, vehicle diagnosis and mine safety need a person who is physically there and answerable.

blocks.heading: 11 and 12 First? the Honest Comparison
rows: About 3 years. About 6 if you add B.Tech by lateral entry.
About 5 for a three-year degree and about 6 for B.Tech.
What it commits you to
One trade, at 15 or 16, before you have seen much work.
A stream, with more time to explore. PCM is the broader default if you can sustain Maths and are undecided.
What it closes
NEET routes, because Class 12 science is not studied. Premier engineering seats are mostly filled through JEE, so check each institute.
Little at first. Dropping Maths or Biology later is easy, adding them is not.
The entry filter
Class 10 marks or a short state test on Class 10 Maths and Science. Seats are plentiful in most states.
Board marks, then often a hard entrance exam with heavy coaching for the best seats.
The second filter
A separate hard stage later: the Junior Engineer exam or the lateral-entry rank.
The entrance exam, then placement in the degree.
Cost to enter
Low at a government polytechnic, higher at a private one. See the fees section.
Low in a government school, but coaching and degree fees can be large.

blocks.heading: How Polytechnic Seats Are Filled
rows: Andhra Pradesh
AP POLYCET, a written test run by the state board (SBTET), then online counselling.
120 questions: Maths 50, Physics 40, Chemistry 30, no negative marking.
Seats go by rank, category and your branch and college choices. A weak Maths paper cuts your branch list, not just your rank.
Telangana
TS POLYCET (also written TG POLYCET), then counselling in phases.
SSC with 35% aggregate and Maths. 120 questions: Maths 60, Physics 30, Chemistry 30. Two rank lists: one for engineering diplomas, one that includes Biology for agriculture and veterinary diplomas.
One Careers360 fee table shows total Rs 3,800 at government or aided colleges and Rs 15,500 at private ones, but does not say per year or per term. Ask each college for its written fee list.
Maharashtra
Centralised Admission Process (CAP) by the state technical education directorate, on the poly26.dtemaharashtra.gov.in portal. No entrance test.
Merit from your Class 10 (SSC) marks, with branch, category and college preferences.

You choose to freeze a seat, float for a better one, or let it lapse. Declining a first-preference allotment can remove you from the regular rounds. In 2025-26 about 1.03 lakh students took first-year diploma seats, and 93% of seats were filled.
Tamil Nadu
Online application on the tnpoly.in portal, merit-based, no entrance test (reported by education sites; confirm on the official portal).
Class 10 (SSLC) marks and community reservation.
Special categories may need to apply directly to the directorate. The 2026 application window was reported as May 4 to May 30, so plan for the same season next year.
Delhi
Class 10 with Science, Maths and English, 35% or 3.7 CGPA, and a pass in each subject. 60 questions in 2 hours 30 minutes, with 1 mark deducted for each wrong answer.
There is an upper age limit: for general category 21 years for boys and 23 for girls, higher for reserved categories. A late starter can be shut out.
Uttar Pradesh
JEECUP, an online test, then counselling (jeecup.admissions.nic.in).
For engineering diplomas: Class 10 pass with 35%, plus 50% in Maths and 50% in Physics and Chemistry. Minimum age 14.
Sites disagree on the marking scheme, so read the official brochure.

blocks.heading: Trade By Trade: the Real Daily Work
rows: Computer science or IT
Support, testing, simple web and app tasks. Screen work, constant tool changes, and proof of what you built decides most hiring.
Small software firms, IT support desks, college labs. Few government posts. You compete with BCA and B.Tech holders for the same junior roles.
CSE or IT B.Tech. Ask the counselling body whether another diploma branch can enter it.
Electrical
Wiring, panels, motors, testing, maintenance and safety rules. Plant floor and site work, often in shifts.
Power utilities, public sector units, factories, contractors. Junior Engineer posts through SSC JE and state recruitments.
Electrical or electrical and electronics B.Tech.
Civil
Site measurement, quantity sheets, drawings, bills and supervision. Outdoor, dusty and deadline-driven.
Builders, contractors, municipal and works departments, SSC JE (civil) and state Junior Engineer posts.
Civil B.Tech.
Automobile
Diagnosis, servicing, quality checks and warranty work. Electric-vehicle systems are being added to the same bench.
Dealerships, service centres, auto plants, fleet operators.
Automobile or mechanical B.Tech.
Mechanical
Machines, maintenance, production lines, drawings and quality. Shift work and loud floors.
Manufacturing plants, maintenance teams, workshops, SSC JE (mechanical) and state posts.
Mechanical B.Tech.
Electronics and communication
Testing and repairing boards, telecom installation, instruments, soldering. Fine, patient bench work.
Electronics makers, telecom service firms, repair and installation businesses.
Electronics and communication B.Tech.

blocks.heading: Trades Ranked By Growth and Sales Layer
rows: Computer science or IT
Scalable
Only when you build visible projects, because a diploma alone is crowded. Skills then sell directly as freelance work or a small studio.
Who pays: small businesses and employers. First sales step: one finished project with a plain two-line description of who it helps.
Electrical
Scalable with a business layer
The salaried ladder is fixed. Wiring, panel work, solar and EV-charger installation are local services that households and shops pay for directly.
Who pays: households, shops, builders. First sales step: a photo log of finished jobs and a simple price per job, then ask each happy customer for one referral.
Civil
Salaried site roles are modest. Estimation, small contracting and drawing services give a business layer.
Who pays: home owners, builders, contractors. First sales step: a clear quantity-and-cost sheet you can show before a quote.
Automobile
Dealership pay follows a ladder. A garage or an EV-service workshop is the layer.
Who pays: vehicle owners and fleets. First sales step: a repeat-service reminder list and honest written estimates.
Mechanical
Plant jobs are crowded and follow a ladder. Maintenance contracts, fabrication and tooling work are the layer.
Who pays: small factories and workshops. First sales step: one repair or fabrication job done well, documented with before and after photos.
Electronics and communication
Salaried roles are modest. Repair, installation and embedded-project work can be sold directly.
Who pays: shops, offices, small makers. First sales step: a short list of the fixes you do and a fixed price for each.

blocks.heading: Job Routes: Government, Apprenticeship and Private
rows: SSC Junior Engineer (civil, electrical, mechanical)

The 2026 notice listed 1,748 posts at Pay Level 6, Rs 35,400 to Rs 1,12,400 under the 7th Pay Commission. Civil, electrical and mechanical posts accept a diploma or a degree, with experience where prescribed. Applications ran from 2 to 22 September 2026.
You compete with engineering graduates for the same posts. Age limit is generally 30, 32 for certain posts. A written exam and document checks sit on top of the diploma.
Other public routes
State Junior Engineer posts, railway recruitment and public sector technician posts also take diploma holders. The exact diploma branch is set by each notice.
Posts and cycles vary. Treat any one exam as a bet, and keep a skill that pays if the attempt fails.
Apprenticeship (NATS)

A law-firm summary of the revised rules gives minimum monthly stipends from 1 April 2026: Rs 9,600 for technician (vocational) and sandwich-course apprentices from diploma institutions, Rs 10,900 for technician apprentices or diploma holders, and Rs 12,300 for graduates. The government shares 50% of the prescribed minimum stipend, and many firms pay more.
Confirm which row applies to you on the official NATS site . Seats depend on employers who register to take apprentices.
Private plants, contractors and service shops
The widest route. We could not find a reliable diploma-only pay survey, so we give no private figure.

Pay differs by city, employer and skill. Check current listings and ask people working in the trade. Pay figures here are indicative ranges and averages from public profiles, not exact or guaranteed amounts.
